## 🧪 Test build for 0.2.6 (rc.2)

### 🖥️ Built-in Remote Desktop
- The RDP engine is now built from current IronRDP sources. The previous one could be refused by Windows 11 at sign-in even with the right user name and password (the system client got in, Terminyxx didn't).
- A refused sign-in now always asks for the password again instead of showing a technical error.

### 🍎 macOS
- Terminyxx now asks macOS for the **Local Network** permission it needs to reach SSH and RDP servers on your network. If a connection to a 192.168.x.x address fails with "no route to host", the error now says where to turn the permission on (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network).
- The password hint in the RDP host dialog no longer claims a saved password isn't used.

### 🧭 Also in this build
- The title-bar **+** button is now a **Home** button (it always went back to the start screen), and the collapsed sidebar no longer has a second expand button. Thanks to @Xstrwe.
- Tunnels limit how many connections they forward at once.
